baseline_mechanics.non_defining_emission: fixed Student-t with 7 degrees of freedom

credential_policy: offline; no environment credential is read
selection_rationale: The reduced core keeps the three evidence models supported by the locked component experiments: initial claims, the joint real-retail/implicit-price consumer response, and the joint capital-goods activity/pipeline response. It excludes JOLTS, aggregate housing, both legacy input costs and import prices, vehicle sales, and continued claims. Inflation expectations is retained only as a named sensitivity because the historical real-time feed produced too few applied updates to establish its incremental value.
validation_scope: operational promotion after same-history development; not a fresh out-of-sample validation
